description: This PHP class 'EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair' encapsulates a pair consisting of a collection (likely LDAP entries) and a corresponding lookup setting, providing accessors to retrieve these components. It is part of the LDAP plugin in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair
classes.description: A PHP class representing a pair of LDAP collection and lookup setting, providing getter methods for these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection and lookup setting properties.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Returns the LDAP collection associated with this pair.

methods.name: getLookupSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user lookup setting associated with this pair.
